analysis: The method getMutedFromManager takes an AudioManager and stream type. It checks SDK version: if >=23, calls audioManager.isStreamMute(streamType); else calls audioManager.getStreamVolume(streamType) and compares to 0. Both calls can throw runtime exceptions such as NullPointerException (if audioManager is null), IllegalArgumentException (if streamType is invalid), and SecurityException (if missing permissions). The current code has no exception handling, so these exceptions would propagate and potentially crash the app. To make the code robust, it is advisable to catch these runtime exceptions within the method and return a safe default value (false).
